Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison step. After correctly identifying that Alfred Rolfe died on September 9, 1943, and John Cromwell died on September 26, 1979, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Alfred Rolfe died later. Since 1979 is chronologically after 1943, John Cromwell is the director who died later. The Planner reversed the comparative logic, stating the opposite of the factual data presented in the same step.
